span.p: 四、七项训练奖励

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
奖励中间量
dₜ：当前到源距离，Δdₜ = dₜ₋₁ − dₜ
cₜ = clip max yᴸₜ，yᴿₜ 到 0 至 1
Δcₜ = max 0，cₜ − episode 历史最佳浓度

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
① 距离势函数进展
rᵈₜ = 3 Δdₜ

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
单步总奖励
rₜ = rᵈₜ + rᶜₜ + rʷₜ + rᵗₜ + rˢₜ + rᵍₜ + rᵒₜ

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
② 历史最佳浓度改善
rᶜₜ = 3 Δcₜ
只有刷新历史最佳值才为正

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
③ 触须独立重捕获
rʷₜ = 0.25
先闻到、连续空白至少 1 s、近期仅触须运动
每回合最多奖励 4 次

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
④ 时间成本
rᵗₜ = −0.03，每一步固定扣除

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
⑤ 停滞惩罚
rˢₜ = −0.02
连续 20 步无位置、距离、浓度进展或重捕获

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
⑥ 到源奖励
rᵍₜ = +50，当 dₜ ≤ 0.10 m

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
⑦ 越界惩罚
rᵒₜ = −25，越出 ±1.0 m 边界

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
终止：到源或越界
截断：步数达到 400

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 三、单帧观测与历史堆叠

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
左右读数在线预处理
signal = reading − baseline
smooth = EMA 信号
trend = 窗口内平滑信号的平均每步变化
各特征按尺度归一化并裁剪

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6 维气味特征
左、右 normalized signal
左、右 normalized smooth
左、右 normalized trend

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
双触须硬件可部署基础观测
6 + 2 + 4 = 12 维

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 维左右差分
normalized smooth 左减右
normalized trend 左减右

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 维触须状态
左右实际角度除以 π
左右命令扇区除以 9

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
当前默认单帧观测 oₜ
12 + 3 + 1 = 16 维

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
底盘本体感受 3 维
cos heading、sin heading
上一移动动作编号除以 5

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
blank_age：1 维
连续未检测到气味的步数；若尚未命中过气味，则从 episode 开始累计
blank_age_norm = min(blank_age_steps × 0.2 s ÷ 10 s，1)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ObservationHistoryWrapper
按时间顺序保存 oₜ₋₁₉ 到 oₜ
拼接为策略输入 sₜ：20 × 16 = 320 维
reset 时用首帧复制填满 20 帧

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
不进入策略观测
真实风向、气源方向、到源距离
Puff 内部状态与真实瞬时浓度

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 二、一次环境步

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
联合动作 aₜ
移动 6 类、左扇区 10 类、右扇区 10 类

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
差速底盘更新位姿
前进、左转、右转、左旋、右旋或停止
前进 0.03 m/步，转向约 0.30 rad/步

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
更新全局风
平均风向叠加 OU 蜿蜒
随机模式下风速缓慢波动

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
气源释放新 Puff
初始位置、质量和形状带随机扰动

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
推进全部 Puff
平均风平流 + 每个 Puff 的 OU 湍流速度
同时扩散、质量衰减并清除过期 Puff

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
左右触须转向目标扇区
施加舵机角速度限制
根据机器人位姿计算左右采样点

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
在左右采样点叠加所有 Puff
得到真实瞬时浓度 cᴸₜ、cᴿₜ

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
非对称气体传感器模型
响应快、恢复慢，并加入噪声与可选漂移
输出左右传感器读数 yᴸₜ、yᴿₜ

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
更新气味搜索状态
命中或空白、空白时长、近期底盘与触须运动
重捕获归因为仅触须、底盘辅助或被动

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
构造下一观测、七项奖励与 info
判断到源、越界或达到 400 步上限

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: 一、无障碍场景初始化

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
当前训练范围
2 m × 2 m 平面场地，边界为 ±1.0 m
无雷达、无障碍物、无 LBM 风场

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
设置场景
默认随机气源、平均风向、下风侧起点与朝向
也可使用 fixed 模式进行可复现实验

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
重置底盘、触须、传感器和预处理状态
初始化动态 Puff 羽流并预热 80 步

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: 进入 PPO Actor-Critic
